equations.mechanics: unchanged reviewed constant-viscosity R4.1 Stokes solver
equations.units: SI; cell-average T in K and named binary C as a volume fraction; budgets per one metre out-of-plane thickness
equations.capacity: constant rho0*cp Boussinesq reference capacity, not variable-density compressible mass or latent enthalpy
equations.source: material internal H plus explicitly supplied nonnegative cell heating, held fixed across each accepted interval and added once

numerical_method.name: atlas.thermochemical-strang-mc-ssprk2-2d.v1
numerical_method.splitting: D(dt/2) A(dt) D(dt/2); second-order Strang composition
numerical_method.diffusion: exact-in-time exponential of the SECOND-ORDER cell-centred finite-volume constant-coefficient Laplacian; not exact continuum diffusion
numerical_method.transforms: orthonormal DCT-II in x; DST-II in z for fixed top/bottom face temperatures, DCT-II in z for insulation; one native thread
numerical_method.eigenvalues: 4*kappa*(sin(pi*k/(2*n))/h)^2; k=0..n-1 for no-flux, k=1..n for fixed face values
numerical_method.fixed_boundary: linear stationary lift and half-cell boundary separation; sides always insulating
numerical_method.source_and_flux: stable exp(-x), phi1=(1-exp(-x))/x, phi2=(1-phi1)/x; integrate outward conductive boundary heat from the diffusion substep's time-mean field
numerical_method.transport: unsplit multidimensional MC donor reconstruction and SSPRK2; one oriented transfer per shared face; zero normal wall flux; zero boundary-cell normal slopes
numerical_method.coupling: solve buoyancy velocity at BOTH RK stages after/before diffusion half steps, not frozen start-of-full-step velocity
numerical_method.kinematic_control: explicit frozen PrescribedMACVelocity alternative, labelled prescribed rather than force-derived
numerical_method.temporal_limit: outgoing Courant sum <=0.45 by default and <=0.5 for supported policies, at BOTH RK stages; no automatic substep or lower-order fallback
numerical_method.positivity: MC face values bounded by donor neighbours; outgoing <=1/2 is sufficient for the nonnegative donor/complement Euler bounds in divergence-free flow. TVD limiting can reduce observed order at extrema/contacts.
numerical_method.constant_property_note: no explicit parabolic diffusion timestep ceiling; splitting and transport accuracy STILL need time refinement
numerical_method.no_clipping: raw C excursions up to 64 binary64 epsilon are retained and reported, not clipped or renormalised; larger excursions reject the step
numerical_method.dtype: binary64; Numba fastmath=false, disk JIT cache=false
numerical_method.invariants: heat change plus signed outward boundary heat equals integrated source; binary constituent inventory conserved and scaled against the constituent, not domain volume; independent cell-local advective accounts

accuracy_and_work.physical_epoch: finite representably increasing endpoint time, explicit frame/epoch/problem/source identities
accuracy_and_work.roundoff: binary64 field/FFT/flux and compensated-sum accounting, not physical uncertainty; no retained R1-R4.1 tolerance modified
accuracy_and_work.complement: 1-C, not an independently stored constituent; near-unit C limits the relative precision of a vanishing complement. Raw excursions and both inventories remain visible.
accuracy_and_work.memory: existing WorkBudget admits retained preparation, source capture, candidate fields, fluxes, stage solutions, FFT scratch, immutable results and storage; not a process-RSS cap

references.used: control-volume averages and shared-face convection/diffusion/source accounting; independent implementation, not FiPy integration
two-stage SSPRK2 composition; Atlas derives the multidimensional MC outgoing bound explicitly
MC limiter family; no Clawpack code copied
half-grid odd reflection/DST-II and orthonormal transforms
half-grid even reflection/DCT-II; same discrete operator checked against independent dense face balances

families: T14 coupled interval balance and convergence
PT01-PT06 native bulk, ownership, preparation, budgets
PT13-PT14 source identity and bounded complete-call comparisons
verification.diffusion: independent dense face-balance exponential, integrated boundary heat, linear conduction, fixed and insulating eigenmodes, refinement and semigroup
verification.transport: independent face/matrix loops, bounds without clipping, axis transpose, compact rotating cell-average bump at 24/48/96/192; limited extrema need measured convergence rather than blanket order claims
verification.time: independent dense exponential for fixed-flow splitting on 2x2 plus independent one-circulation-mode Stokes force projection and DOP853 integration of the coupled 8-variable ODE
verification.restart: fresh plan, closed/reopened store and fresh-process same-source continuation; previous runtime acceptance is not rewritten
verification.performance_comparison: same method and input, fused native transport versus explicitly selected NumPy verification backend; preparation, first and complete reused calls recorded separately
verification.benchmark_not_claimed: No complete Tosi convection result or calibrated Earth flow; references validate components rather than the whole planet

example.meaning: authored initial cell averages, evolved by constant-property binary Boussinesq model; not calibrated Earth, Diadem or Tosi benchmark
example.numerical_note: fixed authored dt and resolution, not adaptive or a calibrated geological timescale

unsupported: Variable viscosity/yielding and nonlinear stress solve (R4.3)
Variable density/heat capacity/conductivity, compressibility, reactions, latent or automatically inferred dissipative heating
More than one independently advected binary constituent, full R2 cohort/W02 history migration
Open inflow/outflow, moving meshes, arbitrary geometry or spherical thermal evolution
Automatic timestep selection, coupled damage regularisation or accepted localisation
Full published convection benchmark and combined world/recovery/platform acceptance (R4.4 and later)
Windows/macOS execution or whole-planet performance claims
